title: Paper Analysis Record
description: The structured analysis of one paper. Every substantive field carries its own evidence: the value, whether the authors stated it or the agent inferred it, the page numbers it came from, a verbatim supporting quotation, and a confidence grade. A field the paper does not report is recorded as not reported, never filled with a plausible value.

record_id.description: Stable internal identifier joining this analysis to its paper record.

doi.description: Normalised bare DOI (10.xxxx/yyyy), or null when none was retrieved.

title.description: The paper's title as recorded in its verified metadata.

full_citation.description: The complete reference-list entry in the job's citation style.

agent_inferred_gap.description: A gap the agent inferred from what this paper does not report. Its stance must be 'Agent inference based on evidence' — it is never presented as an author statement.

detected_methods.description: Recognised method names found verbatim in the paper's own text. The verifier confirms each one appears in the source.

detected_countries.description: Countries and cities named in the paper's text, used for the landscape statistics.

detected_software.description: Software and tools named in the paper's methods.

overall_confidence.description: Confidence in the analysis as a whole, from field coverage, how much is author-stated, and how many pages were readable.

missing_information.description: Human-readable names of the fields this paper does not report. Recorded so the reports can state the absence rather than fill it.

analyser.description: Which path produced this record, for example 'deterministic' or 'deterministic + Claude refinement'.

evidenceField.title: Evidence Field
evidenceField.description: One analysed value together with the evidence for it. The stance is what keeps the reports honest: a value is presented as the authors' own only when stance is 'Author explicitly states this'.

value.description: The extracted content. Empty when the field is not reported or could not be verified.

stance.description: How this value was established. The four states are mutually exclusive and reach the final documents.

pages.description: Page numbers supporting the value, taken from the '=== PAGE n ===' markers in the extracted text. The evidence verifier checks that each page exists and that the quotation is on it.

quote.description: A verbatim sentence from the paper. Must be copyable, character for character, from the extracted text. A quotation that is not in the source is a verification failure, not a paraphrase.

examples.title: Rainfall Intensity and Mode Choice in Delhi
examples.full_citation: Sharma, R., & Patel, N. (2021). Rainfall Intensity and Mode Choice in Delhi. Transportation Research Part A, 150(2), 45-61. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tra.2021.01.001

research_objective.value: This study examines how rainfall intensity influences mode choice in Delhi, India.
research_objective.quote: This study examines how rainfall intensity influences mode choice in Delhi, India.

sample_size.quote: We estimate a mixed logit model using data from a household travel survey of 2450 respondents.

agent_inferred_gap.value: Based on what this paper does not report: no validation or robustness strategy is reported; the evidence is specific to Delhi, so transferability to other contexts is untested here.
